files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  How delivery works: the facts as icon cards, then the zones with their time and the order that ships free.
  Axes: layout (full: facts over zone cards, facts: the facts only, split: the facts beside a list of zones),
  tone, density.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { DeliveryLabels } from "./delivery-info.types";
  import type { Feature } from "./feature-grid.types";
  import type { Zone } from "./zone-table.types";

  export type DeliveryInfoProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    lead?: string;
    facts: Feature[];
    zones: Zone[];
    labels: DeliveryLabels;
    layout?: "full" | "facts" | "split";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    density?: "default" | "compact";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Badge from "../compose/Badge.svelte";
  import Box from "../compose/Box.svelte";
  import Grid from "../compose/Grid.svelte";
  import Group from "../compose/Group.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import Title from "../compose/Title.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { cn, fmtMoney, tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    lead = "",
    facts,
    zones,
    labels,
    layout = "full",
    tone = "default",
    density = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: DeliveryInfoProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} title={title} lead={lead} tone={tone} density={density} landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}>
  <Box
    class={cn(
      "grid grid-cols-1 gap-8",
      (((layout as string) === "split") ? "items-start md:grid-cols-2" : "")
    )}
  >
    {#if ((facts?.length ?? 0) > 0)}
      <Grid cols={(((layout as string) === "split") ? "1-2" : "1-4")} class="gap-4" data-testid="facts">
        {#each facts as f (f.id)}
          <Stack gap="4" class="rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-6" data-testid="fact">
            <Box class="flex size-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded bg-muted">
              <LucideIcon name={f.icon} size={20} />
            </Box>
            <Stack gap="2">
              <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
                {f.title}
              </Text>
              <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
                {f.text}
              </Text>
            </Stack>
          </Stack>
        {/each}
      </Grid>
    {/if}
    {#if (((layout as string) !== "facts") && ((zones?.length ?? 0) > 0))}
      <Stack gap="4" align="stretch">
        <Title as={3} size="lg" weight="bold">
          {labels.zones}
        </Title>
        <Box
          class={
            (layout as string) === "split" ? "flex flex-col gap-4"
            : "grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-3"
          }
        >
          {#each zones as z (z.id)}
            <Stack
              gap="2"
              class={
                (layout as string) === "split" ? "border-b border-border pb-4"
                : "rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-6"
              }
              data-testid="zone"
            >
              <Group gap="4" align="baseline" justify="between">
                <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
                  {z.name}
                </Text>
                <Badge variant="secondary" size="default">
                  {z.time}
                </Badge>
              </Group>
              <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
                {z.area}
              </Text>
              <Text size="sm" weight="medium">
                {tpl(labels.freeFrom, fmtMoney(z.freeFrom, z.currency))}
              </Text>
            </Stack>
          {/each}
        </Box>
      </Stack>
    {/if}
  </Box>
</SectionFrame>
